Centum’s Stake: 80.5% Carrying Value: Kes 11Bn Market Opportunities 1. Significant demand for office space located within an SEZ. 2. A youthful population offering readily available skilled labour. 3. Robust business model has attracted significant investor interest to the SEZ.
data.1: Portfolio review – Two Rivers Land Company SEZ Business Model A hub for export-oriented service enterprises ▪ TRIFIC SEZ is domiciling export-oriented service enterprises and investment companies which are expected to significantly contribute to stimulating FDI, creating jobs and boosting exports to enhance foreign exchange earnings. The enterprises within the Special Economic Zone enjoy fiscal incentives, strategic location, access to world class infrastructure and one-stop business support services. ▪ TRIFIC offers Grade A office spaces (grey box, serviced or fitted) to enterprises looking to set up in the SEZ and also offers business support services which entail facilitation of SEZA licensing, recruitment and advisory on regulatory compliance. ▪ Once fully let, the assets developed by Two Rivers Land Company SEZ are sold to long term investors at an income yield via an I-REIT. Progress and outlook ▪ TRIFIC North Tower – an existing building within the SEZ with 16,234 SQM gross lettable area – has been 85% leased. ▪ 14 SEZ license applications for various TRIFIC SEZ enterprises have been approved with 6 applications under review. This is the highest and most rapid licensing success recorded under Kenya’s SEZ regime owing to TRIFIC SEZ’s compelling value proposition and strong regulatory support. ▪ The process of establishment of a Dollar I-REIT is advanced and the TRIFIC North Tower is expected to be sold into the I-REIT upon completion of the ongoing capital raise. ▪ USD 47.5Mn mezzanine finance secured to develop a second office tower with 76,400 SQM. A pipeline of demand has been developed and pre-letting commenced. 14
